purpose: Define the independent fresh-review batches, required checks and promotion boundaries for the 81 prepared card-promotion artifact packs without claiming any review verdict is complete.

scope.selectionRule: Every prepared promotion packet must receive an independent fresh-review verdict before any prepared Source, variable, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer-boundary or downgrade artifact can be filled.
nonClaims: This protocol is not an independent fresh review verdict.
This protocol does not complete any Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade check.
This protocol does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual recommendation, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade or clinical-validity claims.

promotionRules: Only support-with-boundary or bounded-support rows may fill reviewed source, variable, endpoint, uncertainty and transfer-boundary artifacts.
downgrade-required rows must fill downgrade-check artifacts before any downstream matrix update.
reject-source-context-mismatch rows must be removed from promotion and linked back to the relevant falsifier or boundary row.
cannot-evaluate-insufficient-context rows remain blocked until source identity, claim context and transfer boundary are refreshed from primary sources.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 统计、生存分析、目标试验与预测模型方法锚点
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: Confirm exact method role, endpoint language, censoring or bias boundary, and whether the source can support model-position language without becoming calibrated prediction evidence.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 衰老、癌症、重编程、免疫与生物年龄机制锚点
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: Separate mechanism plausibility, biomarker association, animal or cell evidence, and human endpoint evidence; block any direct extension into intervention ranking or clinical validity.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 主体持续性、能力方法、扩展心智与脑保存边界锚点
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: Confirm normative, conceptual and identity-continuity roles; prevent philosophical or preservation sources from being promoted into biological feasibility or personal-continuity proof.

reviewBatches.batchLabel: 数字孪生、AI 治理、相对论时间差分与未来等待锚点
reviewBatches.reviewFocus: Confirm tool, governance, relativity and future-waiting boundary roles; block any leap from redshift, digital-twin or AI-risk material to engineering feasibility or personal survival claims.
